sourceNote: Builder reordered Keystone before Catch after analysis; no geometry/physics changes. Results sorted by current ID order and witness cell IDs remapped via coordinates. Coordinate routes are portable.

model.order: Permutation of first releases of original anchor screws, not the parking destinations or later reparking moves.
model.physics: Actual fixed-step engine, settled before first action and after every move, at most5000 steps per settle.
model.branching: Every legal parking destination is explored for the fixed release order. Full structured clone preserves live-world contact history. No rounded-state merging.
model.outcomes: Solved means a constructive witness, rejected means exhaustive failure within the tier, unknown means a search/settle cap. All witnesses replayed from the initial world in-place.
model.sampling: For8-screw levels only32 distinct orders are covered; authored order and each first screw included. This is not a probability sample or a global count.
model.limits: No claim about arbitrary moving-time input, unlimited reparking, all target trajectories, or whether a narrow puzzle is fun.
